name: superpowers
description: Free Energy's Superpowers fork: simple, essential development with proportional workflows.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for Free Energy Superpowers. These mappings describe actions already chosen by the workflow; they do not require questions, task lists, or delegation on every request.

- Load relevant skills with Kimi Code's native Skill tool.
- When clarification or a user decision is needed, use AskUserQuestion if available and compatible with the session's permission mode. Otherwise ask in the conversation. Provide useful options when they help.
- When task tracking is needed, use TodoList.
- Work inline by default. Only after delegation has been chosen and permitted, use Agent with a Kimi subagent type: coder for implementation/review, explore for read-only codebase exploration, or plan for read-only planning. Do not use general-purpose as subagent_type.
- For a delegated task, pass its bounded brief in prompt and a short description. Keep dependent tasks sequential; use multiple Agent calls or run_in_background only for independent work when those capabilities are available.
- Use Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL, WebSearch, and MCP tools according to their actual exposed names and schemas.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, essential engineering with proportional workflows
interface.longDescription: Existing concepts first, meaningful tests, evidence-based debugging, and review proportionate to risk. A fork of obra/superpowers.
